source: Prachi Pandit, 4 week meal plan, Oct 2026 (FoodPlan.md), plus dishes he named as favourites in the wiki. plan entries are week-weekday, weekday 1 = Monday.

dishes.name: Vegetable omelette and sourdough toast
dishes.detail: 2 whole eggs + 2 egg whites with the week's vegetable as filling, 1 tsp oil; 1 slice true sourdough, toasted; 1 kiwi

dishes.name: Moong dal idli with vegetable sambhar
dishes.detail: 3 moong dal idlis, ¾ cup vegetable sambhar (toor + moong), 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Moong dal idli with carrot-beans sambhar
dishes.detail: 3 moong dal idlis, ¾ cup carrot-and-beans sambhar (toor + moong), 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Moong dal idli with pumpkin sambhar
dishes.detail: 3 moong dal idlis, ¾ cup pumpkin sambhar (toor + moong), 2 egg whites scrambled

dishes.name: Moong dal idli with zucchini sambhar
dishes.detail: 3 moong dal idlis, ¾ cup zucchini sambhar (toor + moong), 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Moong dal idli with drumstick sambhar
dishes.detail: 3 moong dal idlis, ¾ cup drumstick sambhar (toor + moong), 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Oats porridge with whey and banana
dishes.detail: 40 g rolled oats cooked in water until soft, 1 scoop whey stirred in off the heat, ½ firm banana + 1 tsp ground flax

dishes.name: Tofu and egg-white bhurji with jowar roti
dishes.detail: 120 g firm tofu + 2 egg whites with carrot and beans; 1 jowar roti; 1 glass chaas

dishes.name: Lauki-carrot moong chilla with paneer
dishes.detail: 1 large thick moong dal chilla (50 g dal), low oil, stuffed with grated lauki and carrot + 20 g paneer; 2 tbsp tomato-ginger chutney (no chilli); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Foxtail millet upma with whey chaas
dishes.detail: 1 cup foxtail millet vegetable upma (no rava, no poha); 1 glass chaas blended with 1 scoop whey

dishes.name: Carrot-beans millet upma with whey chaas
dishes.detail: 1 cup foxtail millet upma with carrot and beans (no rava, no poha); 1 glass chaas blended with 1 scoop whey

dishes.name: Methi millet upma with whey chaas
dishes.detail: 1 cup foxtail millet methi upma (no rava, no poha); 1 glass chaas blended with 1 scoop whey

dishes.name: Zucchini-broccoli millet upma with whey chaas
dishes.detail: 1 cup foxtail millet upma with zucchini and broccoli; 1 glass chaas blended with 1 scoop whey

dishes.name: Turai millet upma with whey chaas
dishes.detail: 1 cup foxtail millet upma with turai (no rava, no poha); 1 glass chaas blended with 1 scoop whey

dishes.name: Savoury quinoa and Greek yogurt bowl
dishes.detail: ¾ cup cooked quinoa + 150 g Greek yogurt + lots of cooked vegetables tempered with jeera and curry leaves; 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Greek yogurt, whey, banana and seeds
dishes.detail: 150 g plain Greek yogurt (lactase first) with ½ scoop whey stirred in, ½ firm banana + 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds; no honey or sugar

dishes.name: Greek yogurt smoothie with almonds
dishes.detail: 150 g Greek yogurt + ½ scoop whey + ½ firm banana blended with water; 10 almonds

dishes.name: Methi jowar paratha with omelette
dishes.detail: 2 methi jowar parathas (gluten-free, low oil); omelette of 2 whole eggs + 1 egg white; 100 g jeera curd

dishes.name: Moong chilla with tofu and chutney
dishes.detail: 1 large moong dal chilla (50 g dal) stuffed with grated vegetables + 40 g crumbled firm tofu; 2 tbsp tomato-ginger chutney (no chilli); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Methi tofu bhurji with sourdough
dishes.detail: 130 g firm tofu + 2 egg whites cooked with methi; 1 slice true sourdough, toasted

dishes.name: Beetroot moong chilla with paneer
dishes.detail: 1 thick beetroot moong dal chilla (50 g dal), low oil, with 30 g crumbled paneer; 2 tbsp tomato-ginger chutney (no chilli); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Paneer and broccoli bhurji with jowar roti
dishes.detail: 60 g paneer + 3 egg whites scrambled with broccoli; 1 jowar roti

dishes.name: Zucchini moong chilla with tofu
dishes.detail: 1 large thick moong dal chilla (50 g dal), low oil, stuffed with grated zucchini + 50 g crumbled firm tofu; 2 tbsp tomato-ginger chutney (no chilli); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Sweet potato-kale moong chilla with paneer
dishes.detail: 1 large thick moong dal chilla (50 g dal), low oil, stuffed with grated sweet potato and kale + 30 g paneer; 2 tbsp tomato-ginger chutney (no chilli); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Cheese toast and scrambled eggs
dishes.detail: 1 slice true sourdough with a little melted cheese; 2 whole eggs + 2 egg whites scrambled; 1 kiwi

dishes.name: Lauki muthiya with jeera skyr dip
dishes.detail: 6 steamed high-protein lauki muthiya (moong dal flour + jowar, no besan, no wheat); 100 g skyr with roasted jeera and chaat masala; 1 heaping cup cooked carrot and green beans

dishes.name: Rajma, jeera rice and lauki raita
dishes.detail: ¾ cup rajma (soaked overnight, pressure-cooked soft, mild masala); ½ cup jeera rice; lauki raita (100 g Greek yogurt + cooked lauki + jeera); 1 cup palak sabzi

dishes.name: Lemon-pepper tofu with quinoa
dishes.detail: 130 g lemon-pepper firm tofu; ½ cup cooked quinoa; 1 heaping cup roasted carrot and green beans; ½ cup yellow moong dal

dishes.name: Lauki moong dal with khapli rotis
dishes.detail: 1 cup lauki moong dal; 2 khapli atta (emmer) rotis; 100 g skyr with jeera and chaat masala; 1 cup carrot and beans sabzi

dishes.name: Masoor dal tikkis with whipped yogurt
dishes.detail: 4 masoor dal tikkis, shallow- or air-fried; 150 g Greek yogurt whipped with roasted jeera; ½ cup brown rice; 1 cup sautéed green beans

dishes.name: Open egg bhurji sourdough sandwich
dishes.detail: 2 slices whole-wheat sourdough topped with egg bhurji (2 whole eggs + 2 whites) cooked with grated carrot and beans; 1 bowl clear lauki-carrot soup

dishes.name: Jowar dal khichdi with lauki raita
dishes.detail: 1½ cups jowar, toor and moong dal khichdi with lauki and carrot; lauki raita (150 g curd + cooked lauki + jeera); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Bengali bhapa paneer with bhindi
dishes.detail: 100 g paneer steamed in banana leaf in mustard-seed and coconut paste (no cashew, no chilli); 1 cup panch phoran bhindi; ½ cup quinoa; ½ cup yellow moong dal

dishes.name: Methi moong oats chilla with tofu
dishes.detail: 2 methi, moong and oats chillas stuffed with 80 g crumbled firm tofu; 1 cup beetroot poriyal (no coconut); 1 cup thin yellow moong dal soup

dishes.name: Methi mangodi with khapli rotis
dishes.detail: Methi mangodi sabzi (moong mangodi, very little oil); 1 cup yellow moong dal; 2 khapli atta rotis; 100 g skyr with roasted jeera

dishes.name: Open beetroot tikki sourdough sandwich
dishes.detail: 2 masoor dal and beetroot tikkis on 2 slices whole-wheat sourdough; 150 g Greek yogurt jeera dip; 1 cup bhindi sabzi

dishes.name: Tomato-beetroot soup with roasted paneer
dishes.detail: 1½ cups tomato-beetroot soup topped with 80 g roasted paneer; 2 jowar-quinoa rotis; ½ cup yellow moong dal

dishes.name: Bengali egg and pumpkin curry
dishes.detail: 2 eggs in a mild Bengali-style pumpkin curry (no chilli); 1 cup masoor dal; ½ cup rice; 1 cup bhindi sabzi

dishes.name: Methi moong dal with egg bhurji
dishes.detail: 1 cup methi yellow moong dal; ½ cup jeera rice; 2-egg bhurji with cooked tomato and onion; pumpkin raita (100 g curd + mashed pumpkin)

dishes.name: Tandoori rajma paneer quinoa bowl
dishes.detail: ¾ cup rajma (soaked, pressure-cooked soft) + ½ cup quinoa + 80 g tandoori-spiced paneer (no chilli); 1 cup roasted zucchini and broccoli; lemon-jeera dressing

dishes.name: Caramelised-onion tofu sourdough sandwich
dishes.detail: 130 g firm tofu pan-seared with coconut aminos on 2 slices whole-wheat sourdough; 1 cup sautéed broccoli; clear zucchini and bok choy soup

dishes.name: Egg and vegetable quinoa fried rice
dishes.detail: 1 cup cooked quinoa with 2 whole eggs + 2 whites, broccoli, bok choy and zucchini, seasoned with coconut aminos (no chilli sauce); clear broccoli soup

dishes.name: Moong-broccoli tikkis with khapli roti
dishes.detail: 4 moong dal and broccoli tikkis (⅓ cup moong + 60 g tofu); 100 g skyr with roasted jeera; 1 cup cholai sabzi; 1 khapli atta roti

dishes.name: Masoor dal tikkis with zucchini
dishes.detail: 4 masoor dal tikkis, shallow- or air-fried; 150 g Greek yogurt whipped with roasted jeera; ½ cup brown rice; 1 cup sautéed zucchini

dishes.name: Toor dal khichdi with zucchini raita
dishes.detail: 1½ cups toor dal khichdi with zucchini; zucchini raita (100 g curd + cooked zucchini + jeera); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Grilled paneer with roasted vegetables
dishes.detail: 80 g grilled paneer with roasted zucchini and broccoli and sautéed bok choy; ½ cup quinoa; ½ cup yellow moong dal

dishes.name: Sweet potato paneer tikkis with moong dal
dishes.detail: 4 sweet potato and paneer tikkis (80 g paneer + mashed sweet potato + cooked kale); 1 cup yellow moong dal; 1 cup sautéed turai

dishes.name: Khapli tofu rotis with turai moong dal
dishes.detail: 2 khapli atta rotis with 60 g crumbled firm tofu kneaded in; 1 cup turai moong dal; 100 g jeera curd

dishes.name: Turai and sweet potato khichdi
dishes.detail: 1½ cups toor dal khichdi with turai and sweet potato; turai raita (150 g curd + cooked turai + jeera); 1 boiled egg

dishes.name: Drumstick toor dal with kale poriyal
dishes.detail: 1 cup drumstick toor dal; 1 cup kale poriyal (no coconut); ½ cup rice; 100 g skyr with roasted jeera

dishes.name: Khapli roti tofu wraps
dishes.detail: 2 khapli atta roti wraps filled with 120 g pan-seared firm tofu, roasted sweet potato and sautéed kale; 80 g jeera curd dip; ½ cup thin moong dal soup

dishes.name: Sweet potato moong soup with omelette
dishes.detail: 1½ cups sweet potato, moong dal and kale soup; 2-egg vegetable omelette; ½ cup rice

dishes.name: Yellow moong dal with egg bhurji
dishes.detail: 1 cup yellow moong dal; ½ cup jeera rice; 2-egg bhurji with cooked tomato and onion; turai raita (100 g curd + cooked turai)

dishes.name: Home-made khao suey with tofu
dishes.detail: Mild coconut curry (no chilli) with 120 g firm tofu, broccoli and carrot over rice noodles; fried-onion and lemon toppings

dishes.name: Matar paneer with jeera rice
dishes.detail: Matar paneer with 80 g paneer in a mild onion-tomato gravy (no cashew, no chilli); ½ cup jeera rice; 1 cup cooked seasonal sabzi

dishes.name: Dal palak with seasonal sabzi
dishes.detail: 1½ cups dal palak (toor + yellow moong); seasonal sabzi, homemade yogurt if wanted; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Palak paneer with masoor dal
dishes.detail: Palak paneer with 80 g paneer; ½ cup masoor dal; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Toor dal tadka with egg curry
dishes.detail: 1 cup toor dal tadka; 2 eggs in a mild onion-tomato gravy (no chilli); 1 cup green beans poriyal; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Masoor vegetable soup with egg bhurji
dishes.detail: 1½ cups masoor lentil soup with carrot, lauki and palak; 2-egg bhurji (his rule: no omelette at dinner); ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Tofu and green beans masala stir-fry
dishes.detail: 130 g firm tofu stir-fried with green beans in a mild masala; ½ cup yellow moong dal; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Palak moong dal with tawa paneer
dishes.detail: 1 cup palak moong dal; 60 g tawa paneer; 1 cup carrot and beans sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Mixed sabzi, masoor dal and egg bhurji
dishes.detail: Mixed vegetable sabzi (lauki, carrot, beans); 1 cup masoor dal; 2-egg bhurji; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Toor dal tadka with egg bhurji and bhindi

dishes.name: Tofu and bhindi masala stir-fry

dishes.name: Beetroot masoor soup with tawa paneer
dishes.detail: 1½ cups beetroot and masoor lentil soup; 60 g tawa paneer; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Egg curry with pumpkin and methi dal

dishes.name: Methi toor dal with dry pumpkin sabzi
dishes.detail: 1½ cups methi toor dal; 1 cup dry pumpkin sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Mild methi tofu curry
dishes.detail: Mild methi curry with 120 g firm tofu; ½ cup masoor dal; 1 cup beetroot poriyal; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Cholai moong dal with broccoli sabzi

dishes.name: Egg curry with toor dal and zucchini
dishes.detail: 2 eggs in a mild onion-tomato gravy (no chilli); 1 cup toor dal; 1 cup zucchini sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Ginger tofu with stir-fried bok choy
dishes.detail: 130 g ginger tofu with Asian stir-fried bok choy (coconut aminos, no chilli); ½ cup masoor dal; 1 cup cholai sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Masoor zucchini soup with egg bhurji
dishes.detail: 1½ cups masoor lentil soup with zucchini; 2-egg bhurji (his rule: no omelette at dinner); 1 cup broccoli sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Coconut-ginger egg curry with broccoli
dishes.detail: 2 eggs in a mild coconut-ginger curry with broccoli and bok choy; 1½ cups thin yellow moong dal soup; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Moong dal tadka with bok choy and bhurji
dishes.detail: 1 cup moong dal tadka; 1 cup ginger and cooked-garlic bok choy stir-fry; 2-egg bhurji; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Toor-masoor dal with broccoli and cholai
dishes.detail: 1½ cups toor and masoor mixed dal; 1 cup broccoli and cholai sabzi; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Drumstick vegetables with moong dal and bhurji
dishes.detail: Mixed vegetables with drumsticks (very little oil); 1 cup moong dal tadka; 2-egg bhurji; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.detail: 1 cup kale moong dal; 2 eggs in a mild onion-tomato gravy (no chilli); ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Ginger tofu and kale stir-fry
dishes.detail: 130 g firm tofu and kale stir-fried with ginger (coconut aminos, no chilli); ½ cup masoor dal; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.name: Egg curry with drumstick and moong dal

dishes.detail: 1½ cups toor and masoor mixed dal; 1 cup roasted sweet potato and sautéed kale; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice

dishes.detail: 1 cup dal fry (toor + moong, cooked garlic tadka, no chilli); 1 cup seasonal sabzi; 100 g curd; ½ cup cooled-and-reheated rice
